finalText:
I dug through all 380 commits and the 127 merged PRs. Under the dependency bumps and refactors, one real feature and ten real fixes. Added the 4.2.0 entry to `CHANGELOG.md`.

The feature: failed webhook deliveries now retry with backoff instead of dropping. The fixes worth calling out: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`, paginated list endpoints stop erroring on a null cursor, the HTTP client no longer hangs on a dropped socket, and request bodies are no longer logged in full.

No breaking changes this release. I left the rest, dependency bumps, refactors, test-only changes, out since nobody installing the package would notice them.
